nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Detective. Glad you're here — take a seat.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: You're new, so I'll walk you through everything myself.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: This is CID OS — the system every detective in this department uses to run investigations.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: No paper files, no separate tools. Mail, evidence, maps, cameras — all of it lives here.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: I've assigned you a small case — a bookstore break-in. Nothing dangerous, just enough to learn the ropes.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Let's start with the desktop in front of you.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: This is your desktop. Every icon here opens one of our applications.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Down there is your taskbar — it shows what's open and gives you quick access to everything else through the Start Menu.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: You can open more than one application at a time, drag windows around, minimize them — it behaves like any workstation should.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Every case starts in the same place. Let's open it.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open Case Management.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Good. This is Case Management — every case you're assigned or can pick up shows up here.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: A case only becomes an Active Investigation once you actually start it. Until then it's just sitting in the list.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Your case is right there — Case 00. Select it.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Select Case 00.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: That's the case brief. When you're ready, start the investigation — from that point on, this system tracks everything for you.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Start the investigation.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: There it is. That panel is your Active Investigation — it stays with you no matter which application you open.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: It always shows your current case and your current objective, so you never lose track of what to do next.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: You can minimize it if it's in your way, but it can't be closed while a case is active — every application depends on it.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Your first objective is already up. Let's follow it.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Every case starts with a briefing in your inbox. Let's check it.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open Police Mail.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open and read the incident report — that's where your case begins.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Nora Finch, the bookstore owner — till was short, and someone forced a locked display case. Straightforward enough to start.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Attachments in a report like this often link straight to evidence. Worth checking every one.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Now let's look at what was actually collected at the scene.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open the Evidence Database.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open an evidence item and read through its details.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Notice the notes field — write down anything that seems relevant. Future you will thank present you.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Evidence tells you what happened. The map tells you where.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open the City Map.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Find the bookstore and inspect the location.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Good. Locations link back to evidence and people — the map is how you see the case's geography.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Not everyone walks into the precinct. A lot of leads come in through Messenger.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open Messenger.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open a conversation and read it.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Witnesses don't always say things directly. Read between the lines.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: If there's a camera nearby, check it. Footage doesn't lie.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open CCTV.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Select the camera, then play the footage and use the timeline to find the important moment.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Bookmark anything worth remembering — you can jump straight back to that timestamp later.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Some answers only come from the lab. That's Forensics.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open Forensics.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Submit a piece of evidence for analysis.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Analysis takes time — check back for the result. Patience is part of the job.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Now let's see who's actually involved. The Criminal Database holds every profile connected to a case.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open the Criminal Database.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Search for a person and open their profile.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Known aliases, history, relationships — all worth cross-checking against your evidence.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: This is where it all comes together — the Investigation Board.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Open the Investigation Board.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Add a piece of evidence, a person, or a location to the board.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Connect the pieces that relate to each other. A board with clear connections is a theory a prosecutor can actually use.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: You've covered mail, evidence, the map, witnesses, footage, forensics, and background checks. That's the whole job.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: When you're confident in your theory, submit your conclusion. Get it wrong and you'll see why — get it right and the case closes.

nodes.speaker: senior-detective
nodes.text: Take your time on the real cases. This one's just to get your feet wet. Good luck, Detective.
